releases.body:
## Fixed

- **Windows credentials lookup resolves cross-platform auth path** — On Windows the plugin only checked `%LOCALAPPDATA%\opencode\auth.json`, but opencode stores `auth.json` at the XDG-compatible path `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` on **all platforms (including Windows)**. The plugin now probes every candidate location (XDG **first** as the source of truth, then legacy `%LOCALAPPDATA%` as a fallback) and tries each until valid credentials are found, so a stale or partial file at one location no longer masks valid credentials at another. Authenticated Windows users are no longer incorrectly reported as "Credentials Not Found".

Fixes #39, #41 (#42). Also addresses Codex review (XDG-before-legacy ordering) and Sonar `node:`-prefixed imports.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/guyinwonder168/opencode-glm-quota/compare/v1.8.0...v1.8.1

---

> ⚠️ **Windows validation pending**: the maintainer has no Windows environment. Reporters of #39 (@weissfl) and #41 (@ErikOHiggins) have been asked to confirm the fix on Windows. If you hit issues on Windows, please comment on #39 / #41.

## ✨ New Feature

**Reset timestamp display in local timezone** — The "Resets In" column now shows the actual clock time alongside the countdown (Issue #34).

### Output Changes

| Duration | Before | After |
|----------|--------|-------|
| Short (<24h) | `4h 36m` | `4h 36m (01:34)` |
| Long (≥24h) | `6d 16h` | `6d 16h (Sat 13:48)` |
| No reset time | `—` | `—` (unchanged) |

### What's Changed
- `formatResetCell()` now appends local clock time using native `Date` methods
- Long durations also show weekday name for clarity
- No external dependencies — uses `getHours()`, `getMinutes()`, `getDay()`

### Documentation
- 📄 New implementation plan: `docs/implementation-plan-v1.8.0.md`
- 📋 PRD updated with Section 1.12
- 📝 CHANGELOG, README output example updated
- 📐 AGENTS.md: Added KISS, YAGNI, TDD, and No-Over-Thinking development principles

### Testing
- 117 tests passing (0 failures)
- Integration tests use regex assertions for timezone-independent CI matching
- TypeScript builds clean, ESLint passes

### Design Decisions
- **No timezone abbreviations** (e.g., NZST, PST) — Node.js `toLocaleTimeString` TZ names are unreliable across platforms
- **Native Date methods** instead of Intl APIs — deterministic, no ICU data dependencies
- **Regex test assertions** — works across any CI timezone (GitHub Actions defaults to UTC)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/guyinwonder168/opencode-glm-quota/compare/v1.7.0...v1.8.0

Resolves #34
